mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tight monetary conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS > 5% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit YoY growth > 5%, it signals a supply chain bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances with both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery, a monthly increase in RSAFS exceeding $500M signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns during post-shock recovery with RSAFS monthly increase > $500M are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 4%) and low CPIAUCSL (< 305) together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to monetary tightening with low inflation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a 0.5pp increase in UNRATE within 2 months signals labor market weakening, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with UNRATE increase > 0.5pp in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth > 3% and PAYEMS growth < 1% (both YoY), it signals a supply chain capacity issue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 3% and PAYEMS YoY growth < 1%
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns in instances with INDPRO YoY growth > 3% and PAYEMS YoY growth < 1% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).
